name: Model
h1: Single point of access: accel | torque | series | partials | rhs | budget

name: Options
h1: Validated option set with fidelity presets

name: const
h1: Constants owned by the toolbox

name: toolboxVersion
h1: Semantic version (single authority)

name: dependencyReport
h1: Presence and version of the ecosystem toolboxes

name: fail
h1: Uniform error raising with identifier taxonomy and correction hints

name: provenance
h1: Metadata record that travels with every result

name: buildMex
h1: Build the MEX gateways in mex/ (msis kernel; never committed) or report their state

name: readACC1B
h1: ACC1B/ACT1B/ACH1B reader over gracefoReading (3xK SRF accelerations + aux)

name: readSCA1B
h1: SCA1B reader: ICRF->SRF quaternions conjugated once to BODY->GCRS

name: readGNV1B
h1: GNV1B reader: ITRS state rotated to GCRS via referenceSystem

name: readTHR1B
h1: THR1B thruster event reader (impulse priors for qc)

name: readMAS1B
h1: MAS1B tank-mass reader (NOT spacecraft mass)

name: readMAG1B
h1: MAG1B reader: measured field (SI) and magnetorquer branch and net currents

name: massModel
h1: Spacecraft mass model: handbook constant or MAS1B-driven variable mass

name: spaceWeather
h1: Space-weather provider with query(epoch): F10.7 F30 S/M/Y10.7 Ap Kp Dst

name: importCERES
h1: CERES SYN1deg/EBAF netCDF import into radiance grids

name: igrfCoefficients
h1: IGRF-14 coefficient loader with the model's own interpolation and SV rule

name: density
h1: Thermosphere density and composition dispatcher (exponential msis00 msis21 dtm2020 jb2008)

name: wind
h1: Relative-velocity builder: co-rotation from referenceSystem plus an optional wind field

name: eclipseFactor
h1: Shadow function nu from 0 to 1: cylindrical conical solaarsCF plus lunar

name: earthRadiance
h1: Earth albedo and IR radiance grids (pointSource knocke ceres) with ADM anisotropy

name: magneticField
h1: IGRF-14 geomagnetic field in ITRS and body frame

name: radiationSources
h1: Source list {dir_body P band} from Sun and Earth radiance for one epoch batch

name: MacroModel
h1: Panel geometry frozen and validated once

name: graceFO
h1: GRACE-FO macro model from JPL D-56935

name: boxWing
h1: Generic box-wing macro model factory

name: selfShadow
h1: Per-panel exposed fraction: exact ray-cast or icosphere LUT

name: thermalState
h1: Per-panel temperatures: steady state or transient (Wöske)

name: AttitudeProvider
h1: BODY->GCRS quaternions at query epochs (SCA1B or nominal) via referenceSystem.interpolateQuaternions

name: checkAttitudeSense
h1: Physics test of quaternion sense (nadir and line-of-sight)

name: gsiCoefficients
h1: Normal and tangential plate coefficients: sentman maxwell constantCd (cll/schamberg refuse)

name: accommodation
h1: Energy accommodation coefficient: fixed (sesam/langmuir refuse until O-16)

name: dragPanelForce
h1: Per-panel gas-momentum force in body frame

name: radiationPanelForce
h1: Per-panel radiation force for a source list in body frame

name: thermalRecoil
h1: Per-panel thermal re-emission recoil force

name: assemble
h1: Reductions: F = sum F_k and tau = sum (r_k - r_cm) x F_k

name: bodyTorques
h1: Gravity-gradient and magnetic body torques

name: partials
h1: Analytic per-panel derivatives: alpha densityScale speed pressureScale temperature

name: singleEpoch
h1: Compiled single-epoch kernel: gas radiation and thermal recoil with their reductions

name: Sensor
h1: Abstract measurement model: observe / partials / noiseModel

name: Electrostatic
h1: Electrostatic accelerometer: bias scale matrix proof-mass offset coupling FIR filter

name: AtomInterferometer
h1: Cold-atom interferometer: phase = k_eff a T^2 with dead time rotation and the 2 pi ambiguity

name: DragFree
h1: Drag-free residual: sensitivity high-pass cascade with actuator saturation

name: residuals
h1: Whitened residuals measured - modelled with preliminary calibration

name: hampel
h1: Robust point-outlier detector (moving median + MAD)

name: detectImpulses
h1: Matched filter on the CRN impulse response with THR1B priors

name: detectJumps
h1: Piecewise-constant/linear change-point detection (PELT + BIC)

name: eventTable
h1: Canonical event table constructor and schema

name: screen
h1: Orchestrator: residuals -> outliers -> impulses -> jumps -> mask

name: calibrate
h1: Accelerometer calibration: bias basis + 3x3 scale + jumps by separable weighted least squares

name: forceBudget
h1: Per-effect per-axis acceleration budget over an arc; chunked and across models

name: densityInversion
h1: Thermosphere density from calibrated accelerations; the inversion is a division
